archetype: The Swiss Precision & Obsidian Studio (Dark AI Cognitive Workspace)
emotional_tone: Stealth luxury, intellectual precision, high-velocity cognitive workspace, authoritative and calm

rules.anti_default: Never use Inter for headings. Keep headings in Plus Jakarta Sans with tight tracking (tracking-tight or tracking-tighter).
rules.h1_limit: Hero / Primary workspace heading maximum text-4xl sm:text-5xl (never text-7xl or text-8xl).
rules.h2_limit: Section / modal headings text-2xl sm:text-3xl font-semibold.
rules.h3_limit: Card titles, prompt chips text-lg font-medium.
rules.code_blocks: JetBrains Mono with 13px/14px, muted border, syntax highlight background #0B0D13.

colors.contrast_notice: Every button and badge must guarantee minimum 4.5:1 APCA/WCAG contrast. Hover colors must explicitly set both text and background.

surface_strategy.sidebar: 1px solid #1E2330 border-r, background #0B0D12 with subtle vertical micro-texture. Never fully transparent.
surface_strategy.top_navbar: Solid #07080B with 80% opacity and backdrop-blur-xl, 1px bottom border #1E2330, z-index 40. Never transparent.
surface_strategy.chat_container: Centered reading column (max-w-3xl or max-w-4xl) with generous top/bottom padding.
surface_strategy.user_message_bubble: Background #141721 with 1px border #222738, crisp rounded-2xl p-4 sm:p-5 text-[#F3F4F6].
surface_strategy.ai_message_stream: Cardless editorial flow with subtle left accent line or crisp avatar, markdown formatting, syntax highlighted code blocks with copy-to-clipboard button.
surface_strategy.input_dock: Floating bottom dock with #11141D elevated surface, 1px border #222738, subtle ring focus #6366F1, multiline auto-expand textarea, tool action icons, and lightning send CTA.

visual_enhancers.ambient_glow: Subtle top radial gradient: radial-gradient(ellipse 60% 40% at 50% -10%, rgba(99,102,241,0.08), transparent 70%)
visual_enhancers.subtle_grid_lines: Optional faint 32px grid pattern with opacity 0.03 for architectural engineering feel
visual_enhancers.streaming_cursor: Animated blinking pulse cursor (w-2 h-4 bg-indigo-400 inline-block align-middle ml-1)
visual_enhancers.badge_style: px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full text-[11px] font-mono tracking-wide bg-[#171B26] border border-[#262C3E] text-[#A5B4FC]

brand_hero_abstract.description: Curved black architectural fins creating a rhythmic pattern against dark background - used in Auth modal / Welcome banner

brand_abstract_mesh.description: Curved dark ribbons with soft highlights for login showcase backdrop

AuthModalOrPage.description: Dual Tab Login & Register with A.utomateX RADHA branding, demo credentials quick-fill buttons, password toggling, error toasts

Sidebar.description: Collapsible sidebar with A.utomateX brand badge, New Chat button (+ keyboard shortcut pill '⌘K'), search input, grouped conversation list (Today, Yesterday, Previous 7 Days), conversation title editing, delete confirmation, and bottom user profile popover

ChatWorkspace.description: Main area with persistent session state, streaming response state with auto-scroll and stop generation button, welcome empty state with high-value prompt starter cards

MessageBubble.description: Renders user messages with crisp avatar & bubble, and RADHA assistant responses with markdown parsing, code copy button, timestamp, and token/model meta pill

ComposerInput.description: Ergonomic multiline textarea that expands up to 200px, Shift+Enter for newline, Enter to send, model capability pills, quick clear, file/context attachment mock pill, and Stop/Send button

core_imperatives: Keep everything strictly in dark mode matching the Obsidian Studio theme (#07080B background, #11141D elevated surfaces, #1E2330 borders).
Do NOT use pure #000000 flat black or bright purple gradient (#7351B7 is forbidden).
Ensure all buttons, inputs, dropdowns, and message items have data-testid attributes for testing.
The app is using React JS (.js / .jsx), NOT .tsx files. Write pure JavaScript with JSX.
Streaming must feel immediate with a live blinking indicator and smooth progressive scroll.
Conversations MUST persist in backend SQLite/PostgreSQL database via FastAPI endpoints and reload seamlessly.
Provide pre-filled demo accounts so judges or users can test in 1 click without typing credentials.
ux_details: Include a prompt starter grid when no messages exist in the conversation (e.g. 'Synthesize executive summary', 'Refactor async Python service', 'Design distributed vector pipeline').
Add a model picker toggle (e.g., 'RADHA Omni-4' / 'RADHA DeepThink') in the top bar to give that serious enterprise AI tool feel.
Add a copy button to code blocks and full AI responses.
Use sonner for non-blocking elegant toasts for errors, saves, deletions, and auth actions.
